stories.title: New pizza restaurant opens in Shotton with free pizza giveaway
stories.summary: A new pizza restaurant is opening in Shotton this week. Caprinos Pizza will open its fourth Welsh store at 73 Chester Road West on Wednesday, September 9. stories.title: James Morrison and Jack Savoretti announced as first Live at Llangollen Pavilion 2027 headliners
stories.summary: Chart topping British-Italian singer-songwriter Jack Savoretti and You Give Me Something hitmaker James Morrison have been announced as the first headliners for Live at Llangollen Pavilion 2027. stories.title: World Suicide Prevention Day falls on September 10, with Mind Cymru urging people to talk openly
stories.summary: World Suicide Prevention Day falls on September 10. This year’s theme is changing the narrative on suicide, with the aim of encouraging people to talk about suicide and suicidal behaviour more openly. Mind Cymru says talking about mental health can still feel scary or shameful for many people, and wants to help reduce that stigma.

stories.title: Ewloe church hall to be demolished after asbestos found
stories.summary: A church hall next to the Church of the Holy Spirit in Ewloe is set to be demolished after asbestos was found throughout the building.
